### **SW-TC-IMU-APP-001** — IMU App Scheduled at 200 Hz

- **Requirements Verified:** SW-REQ-IMU-APP-001
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Type:** Unit
- **Status:** Draft
- **Setup:** Instantiate the IMU app with a mock IMU library and a fake monotonic clock. Register the app on a TDM static schedule configured for 200 Hz.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** The IMU app Execute() is invoked exactly 200 times in one simulated second, with inter-invocation period of 5000 microseconds plus or minus the scheduler tolerance.
- **Procedure:**
  1. Configure the TDM scheduler period to 5000 microseconds (200 Hz).
  2. Advance the fake clock and dispatch the schedule for one second of simulated time.
  3. Count the number of times the IMU app Execute() entry point was invoked during the run.
  4. Record the timestamps of each invocation.
- **Expected Artifacts:** None
- **Google Test Ref:** apps/imu_app/tests/imu_app_test.cpp

### **SW-TC-IMU-APP-002** — Single Library Sample Read Per Cycle

- **Requirements Verified:** SW-REQ-IMU-APP-002
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Type:** Unit
- **Status:** Draft
- **Setup:** Instantiate the IMU app with a mock IMU library that counts calls to its sample-read function. Initialize the app via its New() entry point.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** The mock IMU library sample-read function is called exactly once per Execute() invocation; counter equals 1 after one call and 10 after ten calls.
- **Procedure:**
  1. Reset the mock IMU library call counter to zero.
  2. Invoke the IMU app Execute() entry point exactly one time.
  3. Read the mock IMU library sample-read call counter.
  4. Repeat the Execute() invocation ten times and re-check the counter.
- **Expected Artifacts:** None
- **Google Test Ref:** apps/imu_app/tests/imu_app_test.cpp

### **SW-TC-IMU-APP-003** — IMU Sample Published on Software Bus

- **Requirements Verified:** SW-REQ-IMU-APP-003
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Type:** Unit
- **Status:** Draft
- **Setup:** Instantiate the IMU app with a mock IMU library and a software bus instance with a recording subscriber on the IMU sample topic.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Exactly one IMU message is published on the software bus per Execute() call, and its accelerometer and gyroscope fields equal the values returned by the mock library.
- **Procedure:**

  2. Invoke the IMU app Execute() entry point one time.
  3. Inspect the recording subscriber's received-message queue.
  4. Decode the published message and compare each accelerometer and gyroscope field to the programmed values.

- **Google Test Ref:** apps/imu_app/tests/imu_app_test.cpp

### **SW-TC-IMU-APP-004** — Monotonic Microsecond Timestamp on Published Message

- **Requirements Verified:** SW-REQ-IMU-APP-004
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Type:** Unit
- **Status:** Draft
- **Setup:** Instantiate the IMU app with a mock IMU library and a fake monotonic clock whose value is controllable in microseconds and a recording bus subscriber to capture published IMU messages.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Each published IMU message carries a timestamp equal to the fake clock value at Execute() entry, and timestamps are strictly monotonically non-decreasing across cycles.
- **Procedure:**
  1. Set the fake monotonic clock to 1000 microseconds and invoke Execute(); capture the published message timestamp.
  2. Advance the fake monotonic clock to 6000 microseconds and invoke Execute(); capture the published message timestamp.
  3. Advance the fake monotonic clock to 11000 microseconds and invoke Execute(); capture the published message timestamp.
  4. Compare each captured timestamp to the fake clock value at the time of the corresponding Execute() call.
- **Expected Artifacts:** None
- **Google Test Ref:** apps/imu_app/tests/imu_app_test.cpp
